```{python}
#| label: fig-nmos-iv-lin
#| echo: false
#| fig-cap: "Simulated output characteristic of an NMOS in IHP SG13 ($W = 1.3\\,\\mathrm{\\mu m}$, $L = 0.13\\,\\mathrm{\\mu m}$, $V_\\mathrm{SB} = 0$) for different gate-source voltages."

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

W = 1.3e-6
styles = ['-', '--', ':', '-.', (0, (3, 1, 1, 1, 1, 1))]
vgs_list = ['0p7', '0p9', '1p1', '1p3', '1p5']
labels = ['0.7 V', '0.9 V', '1.1 V', '1.3 V', '1.5 V']

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(6.5, 4))
for fn, ls, lbl in zip(vgs_list, styles, labels):
    d = pd.read_csv(f'content/mosfet/data/test_nmos_vg_{fn}.txt',
                    sep=r'\s+', header=None)
    ax.plot(d[0], d[1] / W / 1e-6 * 1e-6, color='k', ls=ls, lw=1.5,
            label=lbl)

ax.set_xlabel('$V_\\mathrm{DS}$ (V)')
ax.set_ylabel('$I_\\mathrm{D} / W$ (µA/µm)')
ax.set_xlim(0, 1.5)
ax.set_ylim(bottom=0)
ax.grid(alpha=0.3)
ax.legend(title='$V_\\mathrm{GS}$', fontsize=8, loc='upper left')
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```
